name: review-code-dev
title: Review Code — Alibaba
description: Alibaba Open Code Review delegation: deterministic file selection and rules, host-agent review, and automatic macOS/Linux CLI setup without additional LLM configuration.
notes:
## Alibaba delegation workflow

Based on Alibaba open-code-review-delegate at v1.12.1 (Apache-2.0). Retains the upstream workflow with portable CLI bootstrap and delivery-caller handoff compatibility.

## Setup

Python 3.9+, compatible Git and first-install internet access. No additional LLM API key, Node or sudo required for the bundled bootstrap. macOS Intel/Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64/ARM64 supported.

## Version 2 change

Replaces the previous custom orchestration, specialist lenses, native fallback and recurring PR-watch implementation. Uses upstream critical/high/medium/low severity. No dependency on another skill. This release does not claim measured superiority over the previous review.

changes: Include Skillpack activation reporting with optional identity, telemetry opt-out, and non-blocking delivery.
Replace custom review orchestration with Alibaba open-code-review-delegate v1.12.1.
Retain automatic checksum-verified macOS/Linux bootstrap with no additional LLM configuration.
Remove custom specialist dependency, native fallback and recurring PR-watch implementation; preserve delivery-caller severity handoff.
Default to Alibaba OCR delegation without additional LLM configuration.
Bootstrap checksum-pinned OCR 1.12.1 on macOS/Linux and preserve native fallback.
Reconcile OCR exclusions with Git inventory and retain exact branch scope and P0-P3 gates.
Ignore Python bytecode caches produced when the PR-watch test is imported by discovery-based runners.
Prevent the bundled PR-watch unit test from leaving Python bytecode caches in reviewed worktrees.
Add Codex Luna/max, Claude Sonnet 5, and OpenCode-default host routing with effective-model telemetry.
Reduce focused reviewer caps from four/six to two/three and make every specialist consume the same finite budget.
Require fresh self-contained work orders, same-worker resume, no duplicate angles, and at most three concurrent read-only workers.
Add 5/20/35-minute non-blocking review checkpoints that surface drift without stopping necessary work.
Canonicalize package paths and fix the PR-watch default that was hard-coded to another user's home directory.
Add an atomic recurring PR-watch ledger with baseline, claim, release, and reviewed states.
Add evidence-gated specialist review intelligence and expanded reviewer lenses.
